top.line: A company brain is made for one company, division and team, and you arrive at it.
top.para: Start with a person's brain, then a team's and a division's; the Web Summit team already ran one.

in-short.line: What a company brain is, why it is custom, why you arrive at it, the blocks, our example, the demo.

ask.line: A friend in crypto wants one place where everything is, and an agent that says what everyone did.
ask.para: Not losing time: competitors, platforms and the team, known before you reach the office.

custom.line: A generic brain that fits everyone fits no one.
custom.para: Build the ability to make one, for a company, a division and a team.

arrive.line: Person, team, division, organisation: the same three parts at every level.
arrive.para: A team's brain is made of its people's: the fractal nature of it.

ran.line: At Web Summit I asked my conductor what everyone was doing, and conductors asked conductors.
ran.para: Lanes per agent, keys, command centres, and apps on phone and tablet.

blocks.line: Agents with keys, append-only lanes, a semantic graph, vaults, apps and policies.
blocks.para: What a company brain needs, and what we used.

demo.line: A public vault with a made-up company: pick a level, ask what everyone did.

limits.line: Made-up demo data, our own examples, and the friend's company unnamed.

sources.line: A conversation, our own account, and earlier articles.
sources.para: With links to the two companion articles.
